name: command_gate
description: The MP cost of a command (0x78cf70), the usability gate (0x78c690) and the cost check at the start of a sub-action (0x78ab20, no Copycat running): a stratified subset of the FFX-G07 emulator vectors.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions (FFX-G07 harness); the vectors are the note's own logs, the cost-check vectors have their record resolved from the install's command table

notes: mp_cost: rec {mp (+0x25), type (+0x17)}, chr {autoA (Chr+0x6bc), zeroCost (Chr+0x6ce), buffs (Chr+0x640)}; out.cost.

usable: rec {mp, type, flagsMisc (+0x1c), odCost (+0x26)}, chr {gauge (0x5bc), gaugeMax (0x5bd), extra (0x616), silence (0x609), mp (0x5d4), autoA, zeroCost, buffs}; monster = chr 0x14 to 0x1b; out.cost is the cost or -1.
cost_check: the same record and chr (rec null: no record); out {accepted, mp (Chr+0x6cc), od (Chr+0x6cd) after an accepted check, odMarker (Chr+0x5c0)}.
